text_block_list.text:
One day, while training with Yaeno Muteki 
for the Takarazuka Kinen—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Deryaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: !? Bamboo-san?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We did it-ssu!! A new training course 
record-ssu!!
choice_data_list:
J-Just when I thought she sprinted off at 
full speed...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah! Yaeno--!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Did you see that?! Did you see that?! I 
just broke the academy's track record!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I surpassed Tracen Academy's fiercest 
champions! Isn't that amazing or what!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...I was watching. With the Takarazuka 
Kinen so close, how could you be so 
reckless...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Haha... True! But I don't wanna lose when 
it comes to records, either!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That sounds just like Bamboo-san, always 
going all out.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, you seem to give it your absolute 
all even in the actual races. Aren't you 
wearing yourself out before you can make 
your move?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ugh! You saw right through me...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I really think... it would be best to 
properly manage when to exert your 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'd rather crash and burn giving it my all 
than hold back and regret it, ssu!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno's always calm and composed, sure, 
but... Is she really giving it everything 
she's got, though?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I feel like Yaeno and I are kind of 
similar... Maybe that's why I just can't 
believe that was Yaeno going all out.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Yaeno in the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese 
Derby) was insanely hype, ssus!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"That's why it feels even more like Yaeno 
has power she isn't tapping into!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Was it better during the Derby...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Does it look to you like I'm not giving 
it my all...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Nay, that cannot be. The "obsession" still 
burns fiercely...

The day of the Takarazuka Kinen had 
arrived—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's such a shame Oguri's not running~ 
...Ah, Yaeno Muteki is in it though. She's 
pretty fast, isn't she!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It's way more than just 'fine.' She 
delivers solid results every single time. 
Her skill is the real deal.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Look over there! Isn't that Sakura 
Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Idiot, keep it down! You're causing a 
scene! Still... I'm glad you're looking 
well. You might be back on track soon.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Inari-senpai!! It's an honor to run with 
you! Looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Bamboo! Full of energy today, as 
always!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Look at that fire in you! Keep that 
energy and hit me with all you've got!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: 'Sup!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Yaeno, you're lacking drive! At this 
rate, I'll blow you right away, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The raging flame will remain within me 
until the proper time. There is no need 
for concern.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What's the point of stashing it away so 
carefully?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, fine by me. Just make sure ya don't 
get run over by me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...No matter what words you try to play 
with, my 'Union of Fire and Water' shall 
not falter.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki, here I come!
